name: Ha Long seafood noodles
nameVi: Bún hải sản; bánh đa hải sản
summary: Bún hải sản and bánh đa hải sản are one breakfast bowl with two noodles, loaded with shrimp, swimming crab or cù kỳ, mantis shrimp, fish cake, and greens.
origin: Hạ Long. VnExpress, 16 Mar 2021, calls it a morning bowl.
howToEat: Breakfast. A full bowl has tôm, thịt ghẹ or cù kỳ, bề bề, chả cá, and rau cải or rau cần, with rau sống on the side.
VnExpress gives about 40,000 đồng. Báo Quảng Ninh’s English edition, 23 Jul 2021, says the same.
where: VnExpress names the head of the road into Công ty Đông Bắc, and the Cầu Trắng end of Hà Tu.
seoTitle: Bun hai san Ha Long — seafood noodle breakfast
seoDescription: Bún hải sản and bánh đa hải sản are one breakfast bowl of shrimp, crab or cù kỳ, mantis shrimp, and fish cake.
